mapping.conclusion: module mapping exactly matches selected TF-A; other cores changed ON to OFF using same mapping

mechanism: Linux removes CPU from cpu_online_mask then cpu_psci_cpu_die calls CPU_OFF; cpu_psci_cpu_kill only checks PSCI AFFINITY_INFO.
TF-A lib/psci/psci_off.c invokes native pwr_domain_off then sets AFF_STATE_OFF before psci_pwrdown_cpu_end_terminal WFI; this software state does not confirm PPU power OFF.
Native CPU_OFF only clears POWER_ON bit0 in R_CPUCFG+220+core*4 and sets GIC_WAKEUP_DISABLE bit1 in R_CPUCFG+200+core*4.
Native CPU_ON first sets CPU_INITARCH_AA64, then waits without timeout for PPU_PWSR(core+1)&f ==0 before asserting POWER_ON/HOTPLUG_EN.
CPU0 remaining PPU state8 is sufficient to keep that CPU_ON wait stuck. No new target PLL programming occurred.
uncertain: The specific inherited CPU0 PPU policy or missing bootstrap power-controller initialization preventing physical OFF is not yet proven. There is no CPU0 exception in selected native PSCI code.
decision: Do not repeat runtime A55 offline experiment; do not bypass PPU guard or issue speculative power-controller writes. Root owns recovery.
alternative_proposal: Independent U-Boot early_init_r candidate with only bootstrap CPU0 running, secondary PPUs OFF; switch running A55 mux slow using CNT24MHz timing, warm N19->N39 with PLL_EN retained, preserve DSU/A76/PMIC, keep SPLv4 unchanged. Pending root review/implementation.
